**Review Result**
Overall quality score: **6/10**

Tests pass after installing declared dependencies: `python -m pytest -q` reports **9 passed**. I also ran compile checks successfully with bytecode redirected outside the read-only workspace. I would **not approve this as-is** because the client has a few production-facing reliability and correctness gaps.

**Findings**
- [lumen/client.py](/work/lumen/client.py:172): high - Resource IDs are interpolated into URL paths without escaping, allowing malformed IDs to change path/query structure.
- [lumen/client.py](/work/lumen/client.py:77): medium - `httpx` transport/timeouts are not retried or wrapped, so network failures bypass the client’s error contract.
- [lumen/client.py](/work/lumen/client.py:43): medium - `max_attempts` is not validated, so `0` or negative values create misleading no-request behavior.
- [lumen/client.py](/work/lumen/client.py:180): medium - `batch_create` materializes the entire iterable before chunking, which breaks large or infinite iterables despite the public API accepting any iterable.
- [lumen/client.py](/work/lumen/client.py:164): medium - Pagination silently ignores malformed `items` entries instead of raising, which can hide API/schema corruption and drop data.
- [lumen/client.py](/work/lumen/client.py:242): low - `review()` always sends `"note": null` when omitted instead of leaving the field absent.
- [lumen/models.py](/work/lumen/models.py:54): medium - Literal fields like project status are not runtime-validated, so invalid API enum values enter typed models.
- [lumen/models.py](/work/lumen/models.py:62): medium - Frozen dataclasses expose mutable dict fields, so model instances are not actually immutable.
- [lumen/models.py](/work/lumen/models.py:141): medium - Batch result indices are blindly offset without validating server index bounds or result count, which can mis-map partial failure results.

Estimated rewrite/significant-change size: **about 130 production LOC**, plus focused test additions around the same areas.

issues.description: Resource IDs are interpolated into URL paths without escaping, allowing malformed IDs to change path/query structure.
httpx transport and timeout exceptions are not retried or wrapped in LumenAPIError.
max_attempts is not validated, so zero or negative values produce misleading no-request behavior.
batch_create materializes the entire iterable before chunking, which can exhaust memory or hang on infinite iterables.
Pagination silently skips malformed item entries instead of failing fast on invalid API responses.
review sends note:null when note is omitted, which may differ from leaving the field absent.
Literal enum fields are not runtime-validated, allowing invalid API values into typed models.
Frozen dataclasses expose mutable dict fields, so model instances are not actually immutable.
Batch result indices are blindly offset without validating server index bounds or result count.
